{{Quote|The systems can't ''take'' it... all my conversion modules are ''blowing''!|Han Solo|<ref name="MSW28" />}}
'''Conversion modules''' were patchwork systems used to redirect power from a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] to various sub-systems. They were prone to exploding if too much power was routed through them. [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] worked up some conversion modules when he needed to redirect power to the [[de-icing system]] in order to scorch some [[Stone mite/Legends|stone mites]] off the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon's'']] hull.<ref name="MSW28" />
